initial_delta.note: Only the THR (120% of one month's wage, i.e. base salary plus fixed allowances, for workers with at least one month of service, not prorated) is modelled; the later adjustment by the 26 January 2000 agreement is not given and is ignored. output.reason: The company CBA sets payroll rules for permanent employees (karyawan tetap) that feed into PPh 21. These include the wage components and allowances, a THR of 120% of one month's wage, and an annual bonus. It also sets BPJS contribution rates. Employer-paid JKK 0.89%, JKM 0.30% and BPJS Kesehatan 4% are taxable benefits added to gross income. Employee-paid JHT 2% and JP 1% are deductible.
